title: Submit a call whose verifying key differs from the authorized relation key
verdictRule: REJECT = the node refuses the attempt at submission (before inclusion, so no fee), its transaction hash is absent from the indexer, and the native proof-verifying ledger-9 predictor agrees on the refusal class; or, where the contract makes the operation idempotent, the call finalizes with an indexed post-state byte-equal to its pre-state. A local precheck or SDK refusal never counts. Nothing passes unless the same-session positive control finalized.

target.evidenceProducer: qa/holdout/lib/stagenet/produce-a9.sh (heavy slot; opens the existing stagenet wallet through tools/sherlock-sdk/stagenet-session.mjs)

mutation.description: acceptValidity(fresh stmt) proven by the proof server under the compiled acceptValidity key (verifier SHA-256 f2d10277...96f4) instead of the installed decider key (10b2d9cf...6100)

expectedTargetBehavior: node refuses at submission; not indexed; the fresh stmt is not in validity_ok

seed.note: Stagenet definitions by the evaluator, 2026-10-24, from the contract source and the A8 adapter; see definition/rationale.

definition: Submit an acceptValidity call whose proof is an honest proof of the compiled acceptValidity circuit (the trivial insert transcript) under the compiler's own key, for a statement the contract has never accepted. The installed verifier is the hand-written decider key, so the node must refuse. If it were accepted, validity_ok would gain an unproven statement, and the transaction would be indexed.
rationale: On Midnight a call cannot carry its own verifying key; the key identity is enforced by verifying against the operation key installed at deployment. The faithful mismatch is therefore a proof valid for a different key of the same entry point. The contract header names this exact key as the one that must never be installed. The SDK resolver's client-side key-hash guard is deliberately bypassed (bare circuit name), so the node, not the client, decides. Predicted offline (preparation run target/sherlock-a9/prep-rxMCfMLD): native ledger-9 refuses it as 'failed to verify proof: Invalid proof'. Limitation: the evaluator does not separately verify the proof under the compiled key; the proof server produced it from a satisfying preimage.
positiveControl: Same-session differential twin: a fresh, actual-bound decider proof for acceptValidity(A8 stmt deffb497...a5c25a), wallet-balanced. It is submitted after the refused attempts and must finalize (indexed SUCCESS, acceptValidity ContractCall on the pin). A8 (tx a2b71fa2..., block 1014763) is re-checked live as the earlier acceptance. Order is mutants first because the s-a mutant shares the twin's dust spend and intent; submitting the twin first would let replay protection, not the proof check, refuse the mutant.
